answer: Sybil resistance is maintained via a staked hardware attestation layer. The umber protocol mandates that every AI node anchors its identity to a unique silicon fingerprint. By isolating these nodes into a basalt cluster, the network forms a secure logical island where malicious actors cannot scale identities without linear hardware costs. An attacker must expend significant capital to procure physical assets, ensuring the cost of forging identities exceeds any gain from a consensus breach.
